note: Coordinates from real production incidents, frozen so the geometry that let them through — or that would refuse them — can never drift silently. Deliberately SEPARATE from service_zone_golden.json, which is the approved Phase 0 boundary fixture and must stay exactly as approved.

incidents.summary: Ten ride requests from Kano State, 31 Aug 2026 18:19-18:27 UTC, from a passenger who registered at 18:16 the same evening. All ten resolved outside every active zone. One was manually assigned by Operations to a driver in Onitsha, 666 km away, whose phone was pushed.

vectors.label: Kano pickup C - the ASSIGNED ride RIDE-1788200485896

incidents.summary: RIDE-1787993532992. Pickup in Osun State, ~278 km away, manually assigned to an Onitsha driver TWO DAYS BEFORE service zones were deployed. Evidence that the cross-city assignment hole pre-dates Phase 1 rather than being caused by it.

vectors.label: Osun pickup - assigned to an Onitsha driver

incidents.summary: Where the drivers actually were when they were given those out-of-zone rides. Both resolve ONI exact, so both assignments crossed hundreds of kilometres.

boundaryMargin.note: Across all 932 ONI-classified production rides, the closest any legitimate ride sits to the ONI boundary. This is the narrowest real margin enforcement must respect, and the number to re-check before any boundary change.
